name: Beatrice Waltrud von Kircheisen
original_name: ベアトリス・ヴァルトルート・フォン・キルヒアイゼン
source: Beatrice Waltrud von Kircheisen was a former member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden, being Kei Sakurai's predecessor in Seat V of the Black Round Table, now deceased. Despite being dead as of the beginning of Dies Irae's main story, her influence is still felt, mainly thanks to her connection to Kai and Kei Sakurai, as well as to her former commanding officer.
